name: theinternet-login
description: Login to the-internet.herokuapp.com demo page and verify success flash.
when_to_use: Practice reflex on the-internet.herokuapp.com only; use public demo creds.

phases.name: fill
phases.verify_script: const v = await h.eval('({u:document.querySelector("#username").value,p:document.querySelector("#password").value})'); const ok = v.u===ARGS.username && v.p===ARGS.password; return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'fill mismatch'};

phases.name: submit
phases.verify_script: const ok = await h.eval("location.pathname==='/secure' && !!document.querySelector('.flash.success')"); const txt = await h.eval('document.querySelector(".flash")?.innerText || ""'); return {ok: !!ok, why: ok ? '' : 'no success flash: '+txt.slice(0,80)};

phases.name: verify-success
phases.verify_script: const txt = await h.eval('document.querySelector(".flash.success")?.innerText || ""'); const ok = txt.toLowerCase().includes('you logged into a secure area'); return {ok, why: ok ? '' : 'flash='+txt.slice(0,120)};
